name: Dashboard Block
description: Full dashboard page with collapsible sidebar, stat cards, recent activity table, and navigation.

props.name: navItems

of.name: { label: string; href: string; active?: boolean }

props.description: Required. Sidebar entries; the item flagged active is highlighted. Example: navItems={[{ label: "Home", href: "/", active: true }]}

props.name: stats
props.description: Required. Stat cards with label, value, trend and change text, e.g. { label: "Revenue", value: "$12k", trend: "up", change: "+8%" }. Example: stats={[{ label: "Revenue", value: "$12k", trend: "up", change: "+8%" }]}

props.name: columns
props.description: Required. Header cells of the recent activity table. Example: columns={[{ key: "user", header: "User" }]}

props.name: tableData
props.description: Required. Rows of the activity table; the first five are rendered. Example: tableData={rows}

props.name: title
props.description: Heading used in the sidebar and the page header. Example: title="Ops"

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the page wrapper. Example: className="bg-muted/30"
